name: Wild Biker Boys
source:
The robot wants to play with you again. They move you to the same simulation with the same bikers, but something happened to them that Padar wants you to see.

WBB is cheap ms paint sequel of LBB (Loveless Biker Boys).

[From [url=https://ewwwabug.itch.io/wild-biker-boys]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
那个机器人又想和你玩了。机器人把你送回同一个模拟世界，让你再次见到那群骑手。不过，他们身上发生了一些事，帕达尔想让你亲眼看看。

《Wild Biker Boys》（WBB）是《Loveless Biker Boys》（LBB）的低成本续作，画面使用微软画图绘制。

[摘自[url=https://ewwwabug.itch.io/wild-biker-boys]Itch.io[/url]]
